@CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.run_components : ∀ {Coord : Type u_1} [hfin : Fintype Coord]
  [hdec : DecidableEq Coord] (act : CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.Slot Coord → ℝ → ℝ)
  (order : List (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.Slot Coord)),
  order.Nodup →
    ∀ (old : EuclideanSpace ℂ Coord),
      CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.decode
          (CurrentMain.IndependentEntryFold.runUpdates act order
            (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.encode old)) =
        PrefixNorm.components (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.realDone order)
          (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.imagDone order) old
          (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.endpoint act old)

@CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.selected_minus_half_prefix : ∀ {Coord : Type u_1} [hfin : Fintype Coord]
  [hdec : DecidableEq Coord] (order : List (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.Slot Coord)),
  order.Nodup →
    ∀ (old : EuclideanSpace ℂ Coord) (k : ℕ),
      CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.decode
          (CurrentMain.IndependentEntryFold.runUpdates (fun x v => -1 / 2 * v) (List.take k order)
            (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.encode old)) =
        PrefixNorm.components (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.realDone (List.take k order))
          (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.imagDone (List.take k order)) old (↑(-1 / 2) • old)

@CurrentMain.ReferenceMinusHalfStore.reference_prefix_components : ∀ {Coord : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Coord]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Coord] (order : List (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.Slot Coord)),
  order.Nodup →
    ∀ (old : EuclideanSpace ℂ Coord) (scratch : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
      CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.decode
          (CurrentMain.ReferenceMinusHalfStore.referenceRun (List.take k order)
              { memory := CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.encode old, accumulator := scratch }).memory =
        PrefixNorm.components (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.realDone (List.take k order))
          (CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.imagDone (List.take k order)) old (↑(-1 / 2) • old)
